changelog: Windows Authenticode Code Signing Pipeline with signtool.exe integration
Dual certificate source support: Local PFX/P12 (OV) and Windows Certificate Store (EV hardware tokens like SafeNet/YubiKey) via SHA-1 thumbprint
Zero CLI password exposure: Ephemeral in-memory staging prevents credentials from leaking into process arguments
RFC 3161 SHA-256 timestamping (http://timestamp.digicert.com) and automated post-build Authenticode verification
Non-blocking build pipeline: Preserves output binary on disk with in-place retry signing without full rebuild
Encrypted secret storage: AES-256 PBKDF2 container encryption for persisted certificate passwords in .wtp project files
